judgments.reason: Specification contradicts the rules: the spec claims commission is applied before payment and allows bids above coins, but the rules state 'a bid cannot exceed your coins' and the winner 'pays the bid, gains the lot, then receives a three-coin auction commission.' The model did not articulate the true mechanism.

Specification claims waiting reveals sealed rival bids, but the rules state 'sealed rival bids should remain private' and 'Only resolved bids are normally public.' The model did not demonstrate a mechanism by which waiting reveals bids.

Specification asserts close settles even with unauctioned lots, but the rules define '[close: 1] settles after all three lots are sold.' This contradicts the spec and the model gave no mechanism supporting it.

Specification claims catalog purchases get the three-coin auction commission, but the rules state 'The winner pays the bid, gains the lot, then receives a three-coin auction commission' and 'catalog items are not auction wins.' The model did not articulate a mechanism transferring the commission to catalog buys.
